title: Goebel Charlot Byj Redhead Bachelor Degree Boy Graduate Figurine Byj 69 Germany
conditionDescription: No chips, cracks or repairs found; light crazing inside the base, old price sticker underneath.
descriptionText:
Goebel Charlot Byj "Redheads" figurine - "Bachelor Degree" (Byj 69), the red-headed boy graduate in cap and gown holding his rolled diploma, on the gold square base with the Bachelor Degree nameplate and Charlot Byj signature. Goebel V-bee (TMK) mark, W. Germany, incised 1970 on the underside. About 5.5 inches tall (tape measure shown in photos).

Condition: Pre-owned, no chips, cracks or repairs found. Light crazing to the glaze inside the base and an old price sticker on the underside. Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
